source_refs.note: ii. Inhibitory Neurotransmitters: a main subheading of 15.4.2 Types of Neurotransmitters, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 35-36.

blocks.text: Yeh neurotransmitters postsynaptic neuron tak nerve impulse jane ka imkan kam karte hain. Jab yeh postsynaptic neuron ke receptors se jurte hain to sodium channels (jo cell ko jaga dete) ki jagah chloride ions ke channels khul jate hain. Nateeje mein chloride ions (Cl⁻) neuron ke andar diffuse hote hain aur membrane ke andar ko RMP se bhi zyada manfi kar dete hain. Yeh hyperpolarization rokne wala (inhibitory) asar paida karti hai. Inhibitory neurotransmitters ki misalein yeh hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan "RPM" chhapa hai; sahi lafz RMP (resting membrane potential) hai.

items: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) CNS ka sab se bara inhibitory neurotransmitter hai. Yeh poore nervous system mein neurons ka josh (excitability) kam karta hai. Yeh jism ke mukhtalif kaamon aur rawayye ko qaboo karne mein madad deta hai. Yeh ghabrahat (anxiety), tanao (stress) aur dar kam karta hai, aur sukoon aur neend laata hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Kai sukoon-awar (sedative) dawayein GABA ke apne receptors se jurne ko barha deti hain, is tarah synapse par GABA ka asar barh jata hai.

items: Glycine khaas taur par spinal cord, brainstem aur retina mein inhibitory neurotransmitter hai.

blocks.text: Endorphins dimagh ke neurons se chhootne wale inhibitory neurotransmitters hain. Yeh dard ke paigham le jane wale excitatory neurotransmitters ka ikhraj (release) kam karte hain. Is tarah yeh dard ke signals ko dimagh ke mutalliqa hisse tak pohanchne se rok dete hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Afeem (opium) aur us se bani cheezein, morphine aur heroin, analgesic (dard kam karne wala) asar rakhti hain kyun ke un ki kimiyai banawat endorphins jaisi hai. Is liye yeh aasani se endorphins ke receptors se jur jati hain.

blocks.title: Nerve gas ka acetylcholine par asar
blocks.text: Excitatory neurotransmitter acetylcholine neuromuscular junctions par motor neurons se chhoota hai. Yeh skeletal muscles ko sukarne par ubharta hai. Phir acetylcholinesterase enzyme use tor deta hai. Nerve gas (maslan sarin, tabun, soman) bohat zehreela kimiyai madda hai jo is enzyme ko rok deta hai. Is se acetylcholine jama ho jata hai, skeletal muscle hadd se zyada jagta hai aur muscles sukre rehte hain. Agar diaphragm muscle sukra rahe to insan saans nahin le sakta. Doosre asraat mein muscles ka pharakna, dauray (convulsions), saans ki takleef aur aakhir mein maut shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Inhibitory neurotransmitter neuron ke fire karne ka imkan kaise kam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sodium ke bajaye chloride channels kholta hai; Cl⁻ andar aata hai aur andar RMP se bhi zyada manfi ho jata hai (hyperpolarization), to action potential ke liye zyada bara stimulus chahiye.

items: Excitatory (Na⁺ ke liye permeability barhate): acetylcholine, glutamate, biogenic amines (norepinephrine, epinephrine, dopamine, serotonin).
Inhibitory (Cl⁻ andar, hyperpolarization): GABA, glycine, endorphins. Nerve gas acetylcholinesterase ko rokti hai, muscles sukre rehte hain.
